cases.comparison: Record two separately delivered, sequence-matched candidate recvfrom replies and NLMSG_DONE; retain process birth, UID, executable and sock_diag fd ownership, output and partial failures.
cases.oracle: Native ss and owned listening sockets with matching proc inode and UID; independent protocol syscall probe and candidate-bound per-notification identity.
cases.purpose: Candidate-bound multiple sock_diag receive buffers, distinct controlled rows and independent native owned-socket oracle.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r token </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $token =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
exec /usr/bin/python3 -B "$PWD/multipart.py" run multipart control
